services.name: Helicopter & Glacier Dogsled
services.desc: Helicopter and Glacier Dogsled Tour 1 hour and 30 minutes About The classic Alaskan adventure and our most popular tour! Drive your own sled-dog team on real snow in the middle of summer surrounded by amazing scenery. Start this adventure with a spectacular helicopter ride over glaciers and icebergs. We often see moose, black bears, Dall sheep and mountain goats. Land on a huge snow eld high on a glacier and enjoy a whole hour with Dallas Seavey's 6 time Champion Iditarod Alaskan sled dogs and their mushers that live here all summer long. Take the dog team for an exhilarating dogsled 1.5 hours · 1 landing on snow covered glacier

services.name: Helicopter & Glacier Dogsled + Knik Glacier Landing
services.desc: Helicopter and Glacier Dogsled Tour (Plus Lower Glacier Landing) 2 hours About 2 TOURS IN 1! The ultimate multi activity package: a helicopter tour, a dogsled tour and a landing on the lower glacier to explore the melt pools and crevasses. Depart by helicopter from Alaska Glacier Lodge, fly over glaciers and land on a snow field high in the mountains where the dogs and their mushers are waiting for you. Drive your sled-dog team on real snow in the middle of summer surrounded by amazing scenery. The mushers welcome you on the glacier and you enjoy a whole hour with Alaskan huskies 2 hours 2 Landings · See the blue melt pools!

services.name: Grand Knik
services.desc: Tour 2 hours About This is one of our staff favorites as you have time to really experience the stunning beauty of the area by combining three activities. Fly by helicopter to Lake George Glacier. As the helicopter descents you’ll realize the scale of the glacier ice wall; everything out here is XXL size! See this glacier actively calving from the 100ft ice wall right in front of you. Some of the chunks are the size of trucks! You will have a half hour to explore as you take in the massive size of the ice and take pictures. For your second landing, you will fly high above 2 hours · 3 Unforgettable Landings

services.name: Knik Glacier Landing
services.desc: Departs from Alaska Glacier Lodge 1 hour About Taking off from the Alaska Glacier Lodge in the heart of the Mat-Su Valley to the Knik Glacier the flight time is approximately 30 minutes round trip so the price for this tour is a lot lower. We land right in the middle of the Knik Glacier, where you can get out of the helicopter and spend about 30 minutes on ice thousands of years old with your pilot/guide. We provide crampons for your hiking or athletic shoes to safely hike on the ice and explore some of the cool features. Take pictures of the blue lakes on top of the glacier, Essential On-Ice Moment

services.name: Heli-Hiking
services.desc: Departs from Alaska Glacier Lodge 2 hour and 4 hour Options Available (4 Hour option includes lunch) About This is one of our staff favorites because you have time to really experience the stunning beauty of the area. There are dozens of incredible high-alpine locations the are ideally suited for heli hiking. Most of them have a view of at least one glacier, sometimes two or three. Depending on the weather, your speci c interest and your preference for a more leisurely hike or a steep scramble your guide suggests the best location. After a quick gear check we pack up and board the 4 Hours

services.name: Glacier Swim & Hike
services.desc: Glacier Swim and Hike Adventure Capture Memories on a Serene Glacier Exploration 2 Hours About: Introducing our Glacier Swim and Hike Adventure, a 2-hour journey designed for those seeking a tranquil and immersive glacier experience. This adventure is tailored for travelers who appreciate stunning scenery and a more relaxed pace. Adventure Details: Depart via helicopter on an unforgettable tour to witness the stunning glacier landscape up close and capture breathtaking photographs. You'll be equipped with a dry suit to ensure your comfort and warmth, allowing you to swim in the 2 Hours · May - September

services.name: Heli Glacier Paddleboarding
services.desc: Glacier Paddle Boarding 4-hour adventure on the Knik Glacier Pools. Guests will be given a dry suit to wear while adventuring in the freezing cold glacial water. You and your guide will participate in a few jumps into the glacial lake, making you feel as comfortable as possible getting in and out of the water. This will help to understand the drysuit / Personal Flotation Device system in the event you lose your balance on the paddleboard in the lake, you will feel prepared to get back on. Once you feel ready to take on your paddle, we will connect you to your leash and send you off into the 3.5 Hr Private Tour · Anchorage Area

services.name: Summer Glacier Ice Climbing
services.desc: Summer Ice Climbing 4-Hours Details Depart via helicopter from the Knik River Valley, arrive at your location on the Knik glacier to prepare and learn how to ice climb on vertical glacier ice. Who is this tour for? Adventurous people, ages 18 and older, with a moderate level of fitness. No ice climbing experience is necessary. Tour Includes Glacier ice climbing instructor Water, Lunch Crampons, harness, helmets Ice climbing axes Plastic mountaineering boots Ropes and hardware for top rope climbing. Top rope glacier ice climbing NOT INCLUDED Rain gear Warm layers PASSENGER WEIGHTS To Climb Ancient Ice · Beginners Welcome

services.name: Winter Ice Climbing
services.desc: 4 hours About Take this 4 hour adventure to try something that is completely unique to the Alaskan Traveler. Your guides will equip you with everything necessary to remain safe including a harness, helmet, boots, crampons and ice tools to ensure a successful ascent up the ice formation. Guests can choose to take on a steeper challenge or stay in their comfort zone, this is a challenge by choice adventure! Tour Inclusion PRIVATE TOUR Helicopter flight to and from the climbing area 2 Ice Climbing Instructors Crampons, Harness, helmet, Ice-climbing Axes, Plastic Private · Beginners welcome!

services.name: Winter Glacier Exploration
services.desc: Adventure Hike Near the Majestic Knik Glacier Flight Time: 15 Minutes Each Way (Total Trip Time: 2 Hours) Equipment: Micro Spikes Included Comfort: Hot Drinks Provided 1.5 Hours of Hiking Near the Glacier Warm Winter Jacket, Hat, and Gloves Required Minimum age of 10 years Overview: Embark on a thrilling Winter Glacier Exploration Adventure with Alaska Sundog Guiding. Hike near the breathtaking Knik Glacier, getting up close to the majestic ice formations. Experience the ultimate adventure with exclusive helicopter access, landing in a remote wilderness. Ice skating, trekking, and more!

services.name: Kenai Fjords Landing
services.desc: Departs from Seward Airport 1 hour About Tour Highlights Departs from Seward Alaska Flight over the Kenai Fjords national Park, Resurrection bay, and more Birds eye views of glacial crevasses, house size icebergs and water falls Land next to massive Bear Glacier, and explore on foot with your pilot / guide We often see moose and Dall sheep and sometimes bears Total tour time: 1 hour Flight time: approximately 20 minutes 6% ONLINE BOOKING FEE applied to any reservations made online. To avoid this fee please call 907-272-7777 to book directly TYPES OF HELICOPTERS WE FLY Alaska 1 hour · 1 Incredible Landing

services.name: Seward 30 Minute Scenic Flight
services.desc: Adult: $399 (ages 2+) 30 mins About Fly above the rugged coast of Resurrection Bay on the way to the largest glacier developed from the Harding Icefield, Bear Glacier. Bear Glacier rests above a secluded lagoon that holds hundreds of amazing icebergs. The brilliant blues of the water and the icebergs are absolutely stunning. These icebergs are much larger than icebergs that develop from Tidewater Glaciers and they remained trapped in Bear Glacier lagoon due to the large glacial moraine that separates the lagoon from the ocean. Soar past these incredible 200 ft icebergs on your $399 · 30 Mins

services.name: Seward Grand Glaciers & Fjords
services.desc: Adult: $599 (ages 13+) Child: $549 (ages 12 and under) 1 Hour 30 Mins About Nothing says Alaska quite like glaciers! Tour Highlights ★ 30 Minutes of Breathtaking Scenic Flight Time ★ Two Incredible Routes to Choose From ★ See Kenai Fjords National Park & The Chugach National Forest ★ Greatest Chance of Seeing Bears ★ Fly By Beautiful Icebergs, Tidewater Glaciers, & Hanging Glaciers ★ Epic Photo Opportunities ★ Appropriate for All Ages. Children 2 and Under Ride Free. ★ Complimentary Pick Up and Drop Off at all Seward Area

services.name: Seward Helicopter & Glacier Dogsled Tour
services.desc: Adult: $599 (ages 13+) Child: $579 (ages 12 and under) 1.5 Hours About The checkmark to your bucket list you have been! Explore the beauty of Kenai Fjords National Park from the air before landing on a snow covered glacier where a 6 time winning Iditarod sled dog team is waiting to show you why Dog Mushing is Alaska's State Sport! This unique opportunity to mush on snow in summer has been deemed the highlight of the vacation.The classic Alaskan adventure and our most popular tour! Drive your own sled-dog team on real snow in the middle of summer surrounded by amazing scenery.
